name: terravision
description: Professional cloud architecture diagrams with the official AWS, Azure and GCP icons, from a description or from Terraform code.
long_description:
Ask Claude for a cloud architecture diagram and TerraVision draws it with the official AWS, Azure and GCP icon sets, grouping resources into VPCs, subnets, resource groups and zones the way a cloud architect would.

The diagram appears right in the chat, with zoom and buttons to open the image, edit it in draw.io, show it in its folder or copy the graph JSON. Every diagram is saved as a PNG, an SVG, an editable draw.io file and a `.tvg.json` graph you can change and render again.

Works from a plain description (no Terraform needed) or from Terraform code, where the diagram is derived from `terraform plan`.

**Requires Graphviz and Git** on your computer (macOS: `brew install graphviz git`; Windows: `winget install --id Graphviz.Graphviz`; Linux: `sudo apt install graphviz git`, plus `libgvplugin-neato-layout8` on Ubuntu 26.04+). On Linux, Claude Desktop runs the extension with your own [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Drawing from Terraform code also needs Terraform or OpenTofu.

output_dir.description: Where TerraVision saves your diagrams (PNG, SVG, draw.io and the graph JSON). Leave empty to use the TerraVision folder in your Documents.
